title: Lottie player
description: Any Lottie file (After Effects / Bodymovin, LottieFiles) played once by lottie-web beside a title and a caption; the stage seeks it frame by frame. Without a file the kit's own drawing plays: three arcs draw on their orbits and settle.

source.note: the built-in anim.json is written by tools/make-lottie.mjs (our own shapes, CC0)

props.src: a Lottie .json next to story.json (the build puts it into the page); empty = the built-in drawing
props.title: heading
props.caption: one or two lines
props.loop: true or a number of turns (default: plays once)

example.title: After Effects files, as they are
example.caption: A Lottie file plays on a slide and on a web page, frame by frame.
